title: 第十三章 第六山峰第十四章 意犹未尽
content_zh:
年轻人的声音并不小，自然引起了周围所有人的注意，而姜云也再次停下了身形，转身问道：“还有什么事吗？”
虽然姜云到现在都不知道对方的来历，但是对方对自己毕竟颇为友善，所以自己也不好不加理睬。
不过，姜云并没有注意到，随着此人的开口，连同肖一书等人在内的大部分问道宗弟子，脸上都是露出了古怪的神色。
年轻人微微一笑，却是转头看向了肖一书，抱拳拱手道：“肖师弟，我们那正好还缺一个杂役，不如就让此子去我们那吧！”
这句话一说，众人顿时目瞪口呆，虽然不知道年轻人到底是何许人也，但肯定是问道宗人，而他如今竟然开口要将姜云收为杂役，这等于是给了姜云一个天大的机会，让其加入问道宗！
肖一书也是一怔，旋即皱眉道：“东方师兄，这个，不妥吧！”
“确实是有点不妥！”年轻人一笑道：“不过，肖师弟也知道，我们那本就人丁不旺，人手奇缺，多个杂役，也能让我轻松一些，所以还望肖师弟通融一二。”
“这……”
肖一书还想拒绝，但是耳边忽然响起了一个声音：“答应他吧！”
听到这个声音，肖一书顿时悄然松了口气，面色一整道：“既然东方师兄如此说了，那此子就交由你带走！不过，丑话说在前面，他这也算是加入了我问道宗，故而必须遵守我宗内规矩，尤其是半年之后的复测，如果无法通过的话，那还是要驱逐出去！”
“这是自然！那我就先谢过肖师弟了！”年轻人说完之后，冲着姜云一招手道：“小兄弟，还不谢谢肖师兄！”
姜云简直有点不敢相信自己的耳朵，自己三关未过，可现在竟然已经成为了问道宗的杂役弟子，这让他在回过神来之后，急忙先是对着肖一书抱拳拱手，紧接着又对着年轻人一揖到底道：“多谢！”
“以后我们就是一家人了，不用这么客气，随我走吧！”
看着跟在年轻人身后渐渐远去的姜云，每个人的脸上都带着不同的表情，有羡慕，有鄙夷，有不满，可谁也不敢多说什么。
尤其是霍远，更是暗地里咬牙切齿：“真是走了狗屎运，这样也能加入问道宗！不过也好，只要你在宗内，我有的是机会收拾你！”
肖一书轻轻的咳嗽了声道：“好了，此次本宗开山收徒已经结束，下面我来宣布一下结果。”
结果如何，姜云已经听不到，也无心去听了。
此刻的他就如同梦游一般，跟着那年轻人，在这问道宗内左转右绕，以至于他并没有注意到，身旁年轻人的衣袖甩动之间，一道道肉眼不可见的古怪灵纹没入自己脚下的地面，从而让自己每一步的迈出，都几乎跨越了数十米的距离。
就这样，行了半个时辰之后，年轻人才停下了脚步，看着前方出现了一座高不过百丈的小山峰，笑着道：“小兄弟，此山是问道宗内的第六峰，也就是我们的山头了！”
问道第六峰！

听到这句话，姜云的身体才蓦然一震，回过神来，回头一看，身后有着五座巍峨耸立的山峰，原来不知不觉之中，自己在年轻人的带领下，已经绕过了五座主峰。
不过，他也没有想到，问道宗内，除了五座山峰之外，还有一座这么小的山峰，不禁喃喃的道：“原来，问道宗还有第六峰，而这第六峰，竟然藏在五峰之后！”
这第六峰实在是太不起眼，甚至与其说是峰，倒不如说是一个小山头要更为形象，故而被五峰遮挡，如果不是走到近前，在外面根本看不见。
“小兄弟厉害啊！”年轻人眼中亮起光道：“此山的确名为藏峰，没想到小兄弟竟然能够一语道破！看来，你和此峰果然有缘！对了，还没请教，小兄弟你高姓大名？”
content_en:
The young man's voice was not quiet, and it naturally attracted the attention of everyone around him. Jiang Yun stopped again, turned around and asked, "Is there anything else?"
Although Jiang Yun still doesn't know the origin of the other party, he is quite friendly to him after all, so he can't just ignore him.
However, Jiang Yun did not notice that as this person spoke, most of the Taoist disciples, including Xiao Yishu and others, had strange looks on their faces.
The young man smiled slightly, but turned to look at Xiao Yishu, cupped his fists and said, "Junior Brother Xiao, we happen to be short of a handyman there, why not let him go to our place!"
As soon as he said this, everyone was stunned. Although they didn't know who the young man was, he must be from the Taoist Sect. And now he actually wanted to recruit Jiang Yun as a handyman. This was equivalent to giving Jiang Yun a huge opportunity to join the Taoist Sect!
Xiao Yishu was also startled, then frowned and said, "Senior Brother Dongfang, this is inappropriate!"
"It is indeed a bit inappropriate!" The young man said with a smile: "However, Junior Brother Xiao also knows that our place is not prosperous and has a severe shortage of manpower. Multiple handymen can make it easier for me, so I hope Junior Brother Xiao will be accommodating."
"This..."
Xiao Yishu still wanted to refuse, but a voice suddenly rang in his ears: "Promise him!"
Hearing this voice, Xiao Yishu suddenly breathed a sigh of relief and said with a straight face: "Since Senior Brother Dongfang said so, I will leave this child to you to take away! However, the ugly words are ahead, he has joined our Taoist sect, so he must abide by the rules of our sect, especially the retest after half a year. If he fails to pass, he will still be expelled!"
"That's natural! Then I'll thank Junior Brother Xiao first!" After the young man finished speaking, he waved to Jiang Yun and said, "Little brother, why don't you thank Senior Brother Xiao!"
Jiang Yun couldn't believe his ears. He had not passed the three tests, but now he had become a handyman disciple of the Taoist Sect. After he came to his senses, he hurriedly cupped his fists and raised his hands to Xiao Yishu, and then he bowed his hands to the young man and said, "Thank you!"
"We will be a family from now on, no need to be so polite, just let me go!"
Looking at Jiang Yun who was gradually walking away behind the young man, everyone had different expressions on their faces, including envy, contempt, and dissatisfaction, but no one dared to say anything more.
Huo Yuan, in particular, secretly gritted his teeth: "It's really lucky that I can join the Taoist Sect! But it's okay, as long as you are in the sect, I have plenty of opportunities to deal with you!"
Xiao Yishu coughed lightly and said, "Okay, this sect's recruitment of disciples has ended. Let me announce the results."
Jiang Yun could no longer hear the result, and had no intention of listening.
At this moment, he was like sleepwalking, following the young man, turning left and right in the Taoist sect, so that he did not notice that as the sleeves of the young man beside him swung, strange spiritual patterns invisible to the naked eye sank into the ground under his feet, making every step he took almost span a distance of tens of meters.
In this way, after walking for half an hour, the young man stopped and looked at a small mountain peak that was no more than a hundred feet high in front of him. He smiled and said: "Little brother, this mountain is the sixth peak in Taoist Sect, which is also our mountain top!"
Ask about the sixth peak!
After hearing these words, Jiang Yun's body suddenly trembled, and he came back to his senses. When he looked back, he saw five towering peaks behind him. Unknowingly, he had already bypassed the five main peaks under the leadership of the young man.
However, he did not expect that in addition to the five peaks in the Taoist Sect, there was also such a small peak. He couldn't help but murmured: "It turns out that the Taoist Sect has a sixth peak, and this sixth peak is actually hidden among the five peaks.after! "
This sixth peak is so inconspicuous that it is more vivid than a peak, so it is blocked by the five peaks. If you don't get close, you can't see it at all from the outside.
“Little brother is awesome! The young man's eyes lit up and he said: "This mountain is indeed called Zangfeng. I didn't expect that my little brother could explain it in one word!" It seems that you and this peak are really destined! By the way, I haven’t asked you yet. What’s your surname, little brother? "
